COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_load_revolutionary_destination = {
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_revolutionary_won NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_revolutionary_handed_off } }
 set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_revolutionary_handoff_requested
 load_focus_tree = { tree = COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_focus keep_completed = yes }
 set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_revolutionary_handed_off
 mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
}
}

}

}

COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_mountbatten_killed = {

set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_mountbatten_dead
set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_PEOPLE_mountbatten_dead
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_caretaker NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_mountbatten_handed_off } }
 clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_mountbatten_chairman
 set_leader = yes
 if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_emergency_chosen NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_restoration_pending } }
  set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_restoration_pending
  country_event = { id = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS.9 days = 1 }
 }
}


COLDWAR_ENG_MOUNTBATTEN_handle_external_death = yes
}

add_ideas = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_interim_revolution
COLDWAR_ENG_REVOLUTIONARY_establish_council = yes

}

}

}

 clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_MINOR_PROGRAMMES_extraordinary_route
 set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_MINOR_parliamentary_route

}

}

} }

}

COLDWAR_ENG_PEOPLE_daily = {

if = { limit = { original_tag = ENG IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes date < 2000.1.1 }
 COLDWAR_ENG_PEOPLE_seed = yes
 if = {
  limit = {
   OR = {
    AND = { date > 1973.8.15 check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 } has_country_leader = { name = "A. K. Chesterton" ruling_only = yes } }
    AND = { date > 1977.9.4 check_variable = { ruling_party = 4 } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_revolutionary_won } has_country_leader = { name = "John Gollan" ruling_only = yes } }
   }
  }
  set_leader = yes
 }
 if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_restoration_campaign_started has_country_flag = elections_in_progress }
  set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_restoration_campaign_seen
 }
 if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_mountbatten_chairman NOT = { COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_mountbatten_alive = yes } }
  COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_mountbatten_killed = yes
 }
 if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_restoration_campaign_started has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_restoration_campaign_seen NOT = { has_country_flag = elections_in_progress } NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_support_offer_pending } IMP_ENG_1974_native_government_settled = yes }
  clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_restoration_campaign_started
  clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_restoration_campaign_seen
  clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_interim_revolution
  clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_emergency_interim
  set_country_flag = COLDWAR_ENG_CRISIS_restoration_completed
 }
}

}
